### Nothing Helps Like Hope
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-march-28-2013.html
Passage: Hebrews 10:23
Points:
- Hope is God's gift that imparts strength and courage during harsh trials.
- It supplies fresh energy when we feel exhausted and keeps us moving when tempted to quit.
- It reminds us that God remains in sovereign control during lingering illness or grief.
- When circumstances force us to wait, hope grants us the patience to trust Him.

### Endure With Confidence
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/endure-confidence
Passage: Hebrews 10:35-36
Points:
- Believers must not discard their confidence in Christ when hardships or pressures arise.
- Abandoning this confidence turns away from our only access to God and forfeits our reward.
- True endurance rests entirely upon Christ's faithfulness rather than our own strength.
- We must look away from our weaknesses and fix our eyes on Christ to persevere.

### Remember God’s Provision to Increase Faith
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-april-30-2023.html
Passage: Hebrews 10:35-36
Points:
- Christians frequently forget God's past goodness whenever new trials emerge.
- Holding onto confidence requires deliberately remembering how God delivered us yesterday.
- Past faithfulness proves that the Lord will care for us through future storms.
- Believers should actively remind and encourage one another of God's track record of provision.

### You Have Need of Endurance
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/you-have-need-of-endurance
Passage: Hebrews 10:36
Points:
- Endurance is essential for believers to receive all that God has promised.
- Spiritual stamina is developed through difficult trials and loving Fatherly discipline.
- Hardship has a sanctifying purpose aimed at our ultimate, eternal joy.
- Rather than merely easing discomfort, believers must exhort one another to keep persevering.
